objective: Executable public-market price learning/review/retraining/research-release loop; separate from site production qualification

splits.final_audit_policy: freeze candidate before first use; never reuse as fresh independent evidence after tuning on results
splits.eligible_row_counts: pending builder validation; do not invent
splits.boundary_policy: One excluded day between partitions; training-label and parameter-selection event end must precede the next forecast cutoff. Retraining moves comparisons beyond its new training/selection cutoff.

excluded_inputs: source forecast columns without publication provenance

preprocessing.missing_features: train-fitted imputation with explicit missing indicators
preprocessing.label_construction: use original RT field only; no proxy targets
preprocessing.missing_indicators: Feature schema records appended indicators and transformed dimension separately

candidate.trainable_parameters: regression coefficients and intercept; train-only preprocessing statistics
candidate.meaning: first workflow candidate, not a claim of best forecasting method

uncertainty.method: paired moving-block bootstrap by trading day
uncertainty.interpretation: interval crossing zero means inconclusive, not equivalence

storage.dataset_version_policy: Reuse frozen slices for parameter-only changes; create a dataset version only for actual source/feature/row/split changes

evidence_required: feedback linked to prediction and source row
rollback with real pointer and inference check
nonclaims: This frozen contract is not an execution receipt or an improvement claim
No source downloads or original vendor edits

research_release_policy.initial: D-2 baseline only; no gain claim
research_release_policy.upgrade: paired 7-day block bootstrap upper95(delta MAE)<0 and RMSE<=incumbent

feedback_retrain_policy: Confirmed tune-window review may support parameter-only retraining on the same frozen dataset; promotion/final feedback cannot reuse that comparison window or alter source labels
